_note: cine/cine.gd knobs (design/plans/next-lanes.md section 3; event-ready.md row C). Art direction unless a row says where it comes from. Points [x, y, z] in world metres from the patch centre with y over the ground at that x, z; hab points in HAB 1's own space (its door toward -Z, y over the model's lowest point, the deck at 0.40 m). Text is ids only: the words are story and come on 14 Nov (tr() shows the id until a translation names it).

sleep._note: wake_h: a night ends at 06:30 local solar time, 22:00 plus NASA's 8.5 h sleep (factcheck row 208); nap_h: 20 min, between 10 min with no grogginess and NASA's 26 min pilot nap (rows 194, 195). lapse_s = clamp(lapse_per_h x hours, lapse_s). The drone moves from `from` to `to` looking from `at` to `at_to` (smoothstep, no orbit), each point [m right, m over the ground there, m back] about HAB 1 in a frame turned to the sun's bearing at wake_h (-Z toward the sunrise; cine.gd _dawn()), never world metres: the base's turn of 14 Nov (tools/rotate_base.py) turned world points with it and the shot lost the sun. Over HAB 1, high enough that the crater wall leaves the top of the frame to the stars, ending 30 m behind HAB 1 looking 10 deg right of the sunrise, so a night's lapse ends on the sun breaking over the rim behind the base, about a second before the wake (06:08 of the 06:30 end), whichever way the base is turned. shadow_range: m the sun's shadows reach for the drone shot (the phone preset's 25 m stops short of HAB 1). room_light: HAB 1's light while the crew sleeps, a share of its own. deck_y: HAB 1's deck over its origin, m: a sleep ends with the hero standing in the middle of it (cine.gd _wake(); at the donning bench the body stood in the bench, 15 Nov). hatch: [x, z] of the hatch's inner face, which the hero wakes facing. wake_hold_s: s the wake card holds before E works again

trip._note: The rover drives away from a camera left where it stood (cam: m behind, m to its right, m over the ground, seen along the way it drives off; cine.gd _stand() tries other spots when that one is in a wall or has no sight of the rover) for drive_s (from a standstill at the sheet's 1 m/s2 to its 2.8 m/s, about 10 m: small in the frame, run_m), the screen goes black, the title holds title_s, then the rover stands at the landmark. title_id: the card's text id; trip_to()'s args fill {sol} and {km} once the story writes them
trip._note_turn: the drive-off is the autopilot's (sandbox/rover_pilot.gd film()): toward the edge of the ground on the side the destination lies, round whatever stands in the way. Where the rover must come round first (parked nose on to a wall, the way home behind it: a three-point turn at the sheet's 20 deg/s), drive_s starts once its nose is within turn_deg of its way, at most turn_s later; a rover that faces its way starts at once, as before. Art direction

launch._note: The ascent: the hero boards, an outside shot from out_m away on bearing out_bearing (degrees from north, clockwise) at eye height, the engine kicks dust for ignite_s, the rocket climbs at accel m/s2 for climb_s (tracked by the camera), then the window: a camera beside the rocket (window: m out toward the base, m up) looking back at HAB 1 for window_s, turning toward Earth (the night sky's own planet, DESIGN.night.md celestial) over the last part from turn_at. Earth shows only with the sun down, as on the real Mars. Plume: plume_n dust streams plume_r m out from the pad, thrown at plume_v m/s

opening._note: Sol 1's first hour (cine.gd dawn_hour()): the game starts so that `sliver` of the sun's drawn disc, by height (0.02 is its top 2%), clears the crater rim lead_s real seconds after the loading cover lifts, seen from `eye` (a shots ref: 5 m out of HAB 1's door, at eye height; the door faces the sunrise, data/world.json hab1 yaw). A kid who walks straight out watches it come up; the clock then runs at the day's pace (tuning.json sky day_minutes)

shots._note: Tutorial camera shots (cine.gd shot(name)): the camera leaves the play camera, passes each key in turn (s: seconds from the key before) and comes back to the play camera's exact pose over back_s, one cubic through time eased at both ends. eye and look are [ref, [x, y, z]]: ref 'hero' is the hero's feet turned the way the play camera faces (-Z ahead, +Z back toward the lens), and an eye there is pulled in front of anything between it and the head (shot_margin: [m kept clear, head height m]); 'ground' is world metres with y over the ground there; 'world' is world metres as they are; any other ref is a world.json item in its own space (y over its origin). The 'world' point [2053, 518, 2341] is Mount Sharp's summit on the backdrop (models/terrain_backdrop.glb's highest vertex: bearing 139 deg, 3.1 km). fov per key (default the cine fov). music: a cue started with the shot. sunrise (dawn_reveal): the held look clock runs on from the hour it finds so the sun's centre clears the skyline seen from key `key` (the rim at about 1.2 deg on the sun's bearing, 81 deg) `break_s` seconds in, then at h_per_s local hours a real second (the sun climbs about 14.8 deg an hour there, so 1.5 deg a second: it sits about 1.5 deg under the rim as the camera comes round at about 2 s and stands about 6 deg over it at the end); a clock already past the rise is left alone, never turned back. ref 'sun' is the hero's feet turned to the rising sun's bearing (-Z toward it), so dawn_reveal is the play camera's own distance and height behind the hero with the hero on the left third, back to us, facing the sunrise (Ravindu, 14 Nov: no wide pull-out). orbit [m, m up]: the eye stands where the play camera would to look at `look` (that far behind the hero, that high), so look_around turns like a slow player look (17 s, eased); arm: every frame's eye is pulled in front of anything between it and the hero's head, as the play camera's spring arm does. dawn_reveal (Ravindu, 14 Nov): the play camera turns to the sunrise with the hero on the left third while the sun peeks (take 1), a hard cut to the visor from the front with the sun behind the camera, so its reflection and the sun light's glint sit on the visor (take 2, 2 s), a hard cut to a wide of the hero watching it rise with the title (take 3, 5 s; PIP rolls up meanwhile), PIP's beep, then a glide down to PIP (take 4). cut: true starts a new take at once (its own s unused); each take glides eased. title [in s, out s, fade s]: cine_title (data/lines.json). pip_to [s, spot]: PIP rolls there, facing the hero. beep [s, sound]: at PIP. sunrise.peek_deg: the shot holds the sun's centre that far under the rim at break_s, a sliver of the disc (about 1 to 4% of it) over the ridge, then creeps on at h_per_s. step_out (animation #1, Ravindu's video of 14 Nov 09:50): one eased move from the play camera in the airlock: it pulls back out of the head to behind the hero, the body hidden while the camera is inside it and fading in as one once clear (never seen from inside), then follows close behind the hero on its own line through the hatch while the beats walk the hero out, then onto the play camera's live pose outside (no cut, no drone, no snap). Ref 'body' is the hero's feet turned the way the hero faces; hero_moves: the hero is not frozen (the beats steer it); to_play: the last pose is the play camera's live one. look_around (animation #2, Ravindu's video of 14 Nov 10:09) is a mouse shot: mouse: true turns the play camera itself like a player's mouse (a full circle left round the standing hero at about 18 deg a second, eased in and out over `ease` of the turn, the view pitched up pitch_deg so the camera sits low and the sky fills the frame), after hold_s, ending where it started. outdoors: the shot refuses to play with the hero in a room. to_play shots ease the unseen play camera behind the hero, and over the last glide round to land_bearing (deg from north: 66, the compass of the video's end frame), so the hand-over frames the hatch on the left and the rover on the right however the kid turned the view or the walk arced. pip_moves: PIP keeps driving (the shot films it rolling up); otherwise it freezes with the hero. Art direction: dawn_reveal looks from west of the base toward the dawn sun (bearing about 80 deg at 06:30) and Mount Sharp, the solar field between them; look_around turns clockwise from the greenhouse past HAB 1, the rover and the solar field to Mount Sharp
